correctness.rationale: Let D=K_{6,6} minus the canonical diagonal perfect matching, Q=K_{6,6}, and let M(D)⊂M(Q) be matching/rook complexes. The new theorem is injection on all source 3-primary torsion in reduced H3, not the previously known group ranks. Independently regenerated each matching face from ordered distinct rows and columns, giving augmented f vectors (1,30,315,1420,2715,1854,265) and (1,36,450,2400,5400,4320,720). Built exact integer signed ∂4 matrices for 2715×1854 source and 5400×4320 target. Independently performed 1552 unit integral pivot eliminations on the source and verified every original-column witness identity against the unreduced matrix: 302 remaining columns, exactly 16 nonzero divisible by3. Dividing by3 gives exact Smith invariants (1,1,1,1,1), hence source T3 H3≅(Z/3)^5 (using freeness of im ∂3). Each z_j=(∂4 w_j)/3 is an integral 3-cycle. Independent sparse mod3 boundary ranks are 1552 for source and 3380 for full board; projected classes of these 16 cycles span rank5 in both complexes after inclusion, proving the full T3 source map injects. The target T3 H3 rank10 is known from published tables, not independently deduced merely from mod3 rank. No conclusion is drawn about other primes, board sizes or free homology.

value.rationale: The inclusion from the derangement (crown-graph) rook complex into the complete 6×6 rook complex is canonical, and the behavior of torsion under that inclusion is not determined by previously known source and target group isomorphism types. Injectivity of all five independent 3-torsion classes, rather than just nonvanishing of one image, gives a meaningful exact persistence map that subsequent homological or inclusion-stability calculations can use. Although finite, it is a nontrivial invariant with a specific mathematical reason.
